functional_unit: one correct payload-bit memory service delivered under the declared workload and service policy
implementation_equivalent: one correct payload memory transaction completed under the declared timing/reliability policy

indicator.no_external_sla: I_k = 1 iff the correct requested payload is delivered under the declared recovery policy
indicator.with_external_sla: I_k = 1 iff correct_k and latency_k <= L_max

service_equation: S = E[sum_k B_k I_k]; for fixed B,N: S=B*N*Q
